basic_info.description: Welcome to 721-723 32nd Avenue, a well-maintained duplex in San Francisco's highly desirable Richmond District. Built in 1991, this property is exempt from San Francisco rent control. The building features two full-floor flats, each offering three bedrooms and two bathrooms with spacious, modern floor plans and abundant natural light. The top unit includes a private deck at the rear, boasting stunning city and partial ocean views. Additional property highlights include a one-car garage, extra storage, shared coin-op laundry, a charming backyard, and a bonus one-bedroom unit. All units, including the bonus unit, are currently tenant- occupied with strong rental income, making this an excellent opportunity for an investor seeking steady cash flow or an owner-occupier looking for a multi-unit property.
